description: Award winning Trusted Mobility Server allows an organization to centrally manage an unlimited number of PDA handheld or wireless devices. Access control, encryption, Data Wipe and many more device functionality can all be set and pushed to the device. Trust Digital offers security for Palm, Pocket PC, Blackberry (RIM), Symbian and all windows OSs.
